cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a space-station lounge bar — seated on a chair; a private zero-gravity rest alcove aboard a civilian orbital hotel — catching a drifting square cushion during a gentle weightless turn; a quiet panoramic commuter train curving around an orbital habitat — savoring a flaky breakfast pastry on the way home; a desert oasis at golden hour — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a neon-lit game arcade — holds a smartphone at chest height; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing with one foot up on a step; a night observatory under an open dome — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — perched on a ledge or edge; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — dries her hair with a towel; a neon-lit game arcade — standing; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — standing close to a high shelf or line; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — holds her keepsake at chest height
